identity.name: Palari
identity.concept: A small ceramic vessel whose single colored interior reveals its unique intelligence.

invariants.eyeConstruction: calm half-lidded inset eyes with ceramic eyelids, dark pupils, characteristic-color iris accents, and tiny catchlights
invariants.arms: curved ceramic tubes ending in seamless rounded tips with no hand anatomy
invariants.base: stable continuous ceramic base with no conventional legs or feet
invariants.surface: clean tactile fine stoneware with a matte-to-satin glaze and subtle handmade microtexture
invariants.signature: the Palari seed mark: four larger circular apertures at the corners of a compact rectangle with two smaller apertures centered vertically
invariants.proportionGuard: overall body height must remain at least 2.4 times the visible face height; never use chibi or baby-like head-to-body proportions

materials.label: Porcelain
materials.prompt: soft cool-neutral off-white porcelain, never pure digital white

materials.label: Stone
materials.prompt: balanced warm medium-grey stoneware, clearly grey rather than brown

materials.label: Charcoal
materials.prompt: near-black charcoal ceramic with broad readable highlights and visible microtexture

silhouettes.prompt: tall slender column with a subtly flared stable base
protective enclosing arch formed from one continuous ceramic shell
slender asymmetric crescent with a finished architectural sweep
grounded pod with one continuous rounded ceramic body, an adult collectible proportion, and body height at least 2.4 times visible face height
balanced bell silhouette with a softly flared base and integrated head
two visibly offset interlocking ceramic masses with one clear overlap seam, distinct centers, and a single continuous stable base

crowns.soft_hood: protective soft hood grown from the ceramic body
crowns.broad_overhang: broad asymmetrical protective overhang framing the face
crowns.split_petal: restrained split-petal crown with smooth finished edges
crowns.continuous_dome: simple closed dome with no open top
crowns.closed_asymmetric_sweep: closed asymmetric upward sweep with a continuous exterior cap; no upward-facing cavity or open rim
crowns.soft_overhang: small directional overhang integrated into the anatomy

openings.side_reveal: one controlled side reveal following the silhouette
openings.layered_reveal: one opening created by two overlapping shell masses
openings.low_circular_aperture: one deeply recessed circular aperture entirely below the face, separated from it by a continuous ceramic bridge

poses.arms_resting: both rounded arms resting close to the body
poses.gentle_greeting: one curved arm raised in greeting, ending in one seamless oval tip
poses.one_arm_resting: one arm resting along the opening and the other close to the body
poses.soft_embrace: both rounded arms softly embracing the opening
poses.arms_folded: both rounded arms crossed calmly around the opening
poses.thoughtful_tip: one rounded arm tip near the face in thought

presentation.camera: eye-level three-quarter product portrait with minimal lens distortion
presentation.framing: square composition, full figure visible, centered, occupying about 76 percent of image height
presentation.environment: warm minimalist plaster alcove studio with a matte limestone floor
presentation.lighting: soft diffused daylight from upper left with a gentle contact shadow

forbidden: simple horizontal bowl or cup rim
fingers, thumbs, palms, fingernails, or realistic hands
conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, or shoes
human skin, hair, clothing, jewelry, or demographic costume shorthand
multiple characteristic colors, rainbow effects, or neon glow
robot joints, screens, wires, exposed machinery, or appliance details
random holes or more than one dominant opening
cracks, chips, broken rims, dirt, or antique distressing
cups, mugs, vases, planters, lamps, speakers, or household appliances
generic mascot smiles, chibi proportions, horror, or vacant doll eyes
an upward-facing cavity on a crescent or a circular aperture surrounding the face
a stack silhouette without two visibly offset interlocking exterior masses
text, labels, numbers, logos, or watermarks
